author: supermati10
quote: I grew up with GTA San Andreas and GTA V – games where you could do whatever you wanted: steal cars, cause chaos, pull out weapons and get into shootouts with the cops. That was GTA: gritty, disrespectful and uncompromising. Instead, what I get now is an errand boy who buys flowers, opens doors, fixes the **** sink and plays babysitter while Lucia goes off doing her own thing. The entire game feels like a belated April Fools’ joke – I’m just waiting for Rockstar to release a patch in a few days, laughing and saying: “Did you actually think we were serious?  It was just a joke! Here’s the real GTA VI!” On top of that, I paid €100 for a game with no physical disc, meaning I can’t even resell this ****. Rockstar, you’ve turned rebellion into conformity.
